# Pull request template

[English](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) · [简体中文](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.zh-CN.md)

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, change and important limits. Write this PR title and description in English.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes; generated files match source.
- [ ] Relevant valid and invalid browser flows checked when UI changes.
- [ ] English/Chinese documentation pairs and same-language links updated.
- [ ] Only synthetic examples; no private subtitles or credentials.
- [ ] All CI checks pass before merge.
